keepout.basis: User continuation explicitly withdraws the cylindrical keep-out requirement. It is not treated as passed.

coordinate_authority: A15.json global XYZ and exact mounting planes; three telescope fasteners, four stage fasteners. Image is visual guidance. Payload CG uses JSON Z=125.21 mm, not image rounding 125.206 mm.

material.name: Aluminum 6061-T651
material.source_status: engineering assumptions, not certified allowables; internet search unavailable because search API is not configured; no internet downloads attempted

static_cases.reversed_sign_equivalence: Exactly equivalent von Mises stress and displacement magnitude under the adopted small-displacement linear elastic, fixed-constraint, no-contact model; signed displacement and reaction vectors reverse. Not a claim for real frictional joints.
static_cases.bracket_self_inertia: DLOAD GRAV on bracket elements only, same signed global acceleration as payload case
static_cases.payload: CLOAD at exact CG; not also subjected to DLOAD, avoiding double counting

support.model: All translational degrees of freedom fixed only on the three telescope bore surfaces, as depicted in FEA reference. No base faces fixed.
support.physical_interpretation: ideal bonded fastener bores attached to rigid telescope support
support.contact_preload_friction_stiffness: not supplied, not invented; real joint flexibility and slip unverified

remote_coupling_final.model: RBE3-style weighted least-squares remote translation, equal net weights per stage bore, 8 angular samples at each bore face (up to 16 existing nodes per bore)
remote_coupling_final.behavior: Only three remote equations; stage bore nodes may deform relative to each other. No rigid payload plates or physical connecting rods add bracket stiffness. The payload has only specified translational point mass; no rotational inertia tensor invented.
remote_coupling_final.pivot: Three dependent components at one stage bore node; CG MASS components kept independent for CalculiX compatibility

analysis_acceptance.stress_metric: Maximum unaveraged C3D10 integration-point von Mises stress, no singularity exclusions in safety factor
analysis_acceptance.status: Analyst-selected criteria for unspecified JSON fields; failures/unverified convergence must be reported, not hidden

hardware_assumptions.status: Generic conservative envelopes, not authoritative NAS hardware dimensions or qualification

manufacturing.status: geometric DfM review only; no CAM, machine simulation, fixture validation or supplier qualification
